request_text: Load the 14-bus test case (case14) and disconnect the line between bus 6 and bus 13 (1-based).
answer:
Bus ids are the net.bus name values 1 through 14. Slack bus is bus 1 with fixed 1.06 p.u. and 0 deg. PV generator buses are 2, 3, 6, and 8 with specified active power and voltage setpoints, subject to reactive limits. Load buses are 4, 5, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 and also buses 2, 3, 6 carry net load in addition to generation. Bus 7 has no direct load or generation.

Branches include 15 lines with line_id equal to the net.line row index 0 to 14, and 5 transformers with line_id equal to 100000 plus transformer row index, so 100000 to 100004. The requested outage is the line between buses 6 and 13, which is net.line row 9. That branch is disconnected; all other listed lines and transformers remain in service.

Requested quantities are bus voltage magnitude in per unit and angle in degrees; branch active power at the from side or hv side in MW; loading percent for each branch, but because ratings are undefined it must be reported as 0 for every branch. Totals requested are total generation MW, total load MW, and total losses MW. Voltage overrun criterion is below 0.95 or above 1.05 p.u., and line overrun criterion is above 100 percent, which cannot occur in reported loading because all are set to 0.

Relative to base case, only line 6 to 13 is opened. The AC power flow must satisfy nodal complex power balance on the 100 MVA base with the slack bus covering mismatch and losses. Total generation equals total load plus total active losses if the solution converges.
